name: 指挥脊柱
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app compositional concept, 1440x1000
Primary request: Redesign the Chinese computer-science learning platform ‘词元研究所’ as a restrained science-fiction mainframe mission console. This is composition option A, ‘command spine’.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop app viewport, no device frame, deep graphite-black operational surface.
Subject: a real learning dashboard. A narrow fixed left command rail contains the wordmark 词元研究所 and five navigation items: 总览, 学习中心, RAG辅导, 代码练习, 学习画像. A slim top status strip shows 本地训练状态, 3门课程, 计划进行中. The main area is asymmetrical: a large central 今日任务 / Python 函数 mission block with progress and one primary action 继续学习; a narrower right telemetry column shows C语言, Python, 数据结构 mastery as precise readouts. Below is a horizontal three-step learning sequence: 定位薄弱点, 获取资料依据, 完成代码验证.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished product UI concept, early mainframe operations terminal fused with spacecraft avionics, modern semantic layout, real controls and readable cards, not a poster.
Composition/framing: 84px left rail, 48px top strip, dominant 2:1 center/right split, strong alignment, dense but breathable, one clear focal action.
Color palette: near-black and cool slate neutrals with one selectable ion-cyan accent active; use cyan only for current state, focus, progress, and primary action. No red frames. White text with high contrast.
Materials/textures: matte coated metal and phosphor display character through borders, tiny calibration ticks and status LEDs; no glassmorphism, no glossy 3D.
Typography: Chinese sans-serif for content, compact monospaced numerals and uppercase English status labels. Large headline is not oversized.
Constraints: desktop application screen; clear information hierarchy; every panel has a function; restrained sci-fi, not cyberpunk; no decorative charts; no gradients; no huge slogan; no floating rounded pill clusters; no purple; no red; no neon glow haze; no robots, spaceships, planets, photographs, or marketing illustration; no watermark.
